name: retrieval_bm25
plan: Labelled data already on main: GLM's 111 review findings (audit/reviews/glm-20261120/findings.jsonl), each naming the one file it is about. For every finding whose file is a Python module in worker/repo_index.py's index, rank modules from the finding's claim text with every path and file name removed, by tf-idf (rank, used now) and by BM25 (rank_bm25). Measure hit@3: the true file among the top 3. Rule, fixed before the run: holds (switch the jobs to BM25) if BM25's hit@3 is at least tf-idf's plus 0.05; fails otherwise; invalid if fewer than 30 findings qualify.
